examples.label: Cart quantity picker with subtotal
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">AeroPress Go travel kit <.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="cart-quantity" name="quantity" value="1" label="Quantity" floating="outer" description="Ten per order is the limit." placeholder="1"> <:start_section class="text-zinc-400"> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-shopping-bag" class="size-4" />
Subtotal $42.00
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" full_width>Add to cart

examples.label: Instance resize form with CPU, memory and storage
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Resize this instance <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">Changes apply on the next restart, which takes about forty seconds.
<.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="resize-vcpu" name="vcpu" value="4" label="vCPU cores" floating="outer" placeholder="4" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="resize-memory" name="memory" value="16" label="Memory" floating="outer" placeholder="16"> <:end_section class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">GB
<.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="resize-storage" name="storage" value="200" label="Block storage" floating="outer" description="Storage can be grown later, but never shrunk." placeholder="200"> <:end_section class="text-xs text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400">GB <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="natural" full_width>Review new price

examples.label: Room booking party-size panel
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Who is travelling? <.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="booking-adults" name="adults" value="2" label="Adults" floating="outer" description="Aged 13 and over" placeholder="2" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="booking-children" name="children" value="0" label="Children" floating="outer" description="Aged 2 to 12" placeholder="0" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-number-field" site="Global" id="booking-rooms" name="rooms" value="1" label="Rooms" floating="outer" placeholder="1" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" full_width>Check availability
